## Summary

I added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**: Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC on the specified date by converting the date to a datetime at the last second of that day, then delegating to the existing `post()` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**: Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by posting time (oldest first). Filters using `>=` comparison and sorts by the `posted_at` field.

Both methods follow the existing code patterns and maintain the timezone-aware UTC requirement (documented in the Entry comment). All existing tests continue to pass.
